subject: Data handling confirmation and opt-out (demo follow-up)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@meridianhealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data handling confirmation and opt-out (demo follow-up)

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciated the walkthrough of Meridian's clinical QA workflow. Quick follow-up summarizing the data / privacy items we discussed and the commitments Redwood can make right now: 

- Training-on-customer-data: Redwood will not use any customer production content (messages, transcripts, documents) to train or improve our models unless you explicitly opt in via a signed addendum.
- PII handling: we default to pseudonymization of direct identifiers in logs (names, SSNs, MRNs) and apply AES-256 encryption at rest + TLS in transit.
- Retention / logging: request/response logs (for debugging & SLO monitoring) are retained for 30 days by default in the hosted product; we can configure EU-region retention to 14 days for privacy-sensitive pilots.
- Data residency: we can pin workloads to EU regions for data-in-transit and at-rest residency for the pilot.
- Access & audit: account-level audit logs are available; you can nominate up to 3 Meridian admins for live audit access.

I've attached a proposed DPA addendum (Redwood-DPA-addendum-v1.pdf) that captures the opt-out language and the EU annex. If the EU 14-day retention is a hard requirement for the pilot, Marissa (cc'd) can prepare a short annex.

Next steps I propose:
1) Samantha / Tom — confirm whether Meridian wants the EU residency + 14-day retention for the pilot.
2) If yes, Marissa will send the addendum + DocuSign link (we can accept a PO afterwards).
3) Once signed, we’ll provision an EU-region sandbox and schedule a 1-hour onboarding on provisioning and SSO.

Attachments: Redwood-DPA-addendum-v1.pdf, redwood-log-retention-whitepaper.pdf

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales (Midwest)
Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@meridianhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Mar 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data handling confirmation and opt-out (demo follow-up)

Dylan — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our security/privacy team so we can move forward with procurement: 

1) When you say "transcripts" are excluded from training unless opted in: does that include transcriptions of audio calls and user-entered free text?
2) For EU-region data: Meridian would prefer a 14-day max retention for logs and any debugging traces. Is that configurable per-account or only per-environment?
3) Can you confirm who has access to raw logs internally at Redwood and whether log access is audited/backed by SOC 2 evidence?

Also — procurement would like the DPA on DocuSign so they can countersign quickly. Can you send an executable link once Marissa has the EU annex?

Thanks — if this is all covered in the attached addendum please highlight the clauses so our legal team can skim.

—Sam
Samantha Lee
Security Lead
Meridian Health
samantha.lee@meridianhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@meridianhealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Mar 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data handling confirmation and opt-out (demo follow-up)

Hi Samantha — great questions, happy to clarify and put this in writing. Answering each point below and noting what we'll capture in the addendum: 

1) Scope of "transcripts": any customer-provided content (including audio transcriptions, free-text fields, attachments uploaded to the API) will not be used for model training or offline tuning unless Meridian signs the training opt-in box in the DPA addendum. For the avoidance of doubt we list examples in the addendum (call transcripts, chat logs, document extracts).

2) Retention/config: EU-region retention is configurable per-customer/account. For an EU-residency pilot we will set the default request/response and debug log retention to 14 days; this will be documented in the annex and enforced at the storage tier for that account.

3) Internal access & audit: access to raw logs is restricted to a small ops group (on-call & SRE) and is controlled via role-based access. All access events are logged; Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant — I'll attach the SOC 2 summary and provide the audit report under NDA if needed. We'll also add a clause requiring Redwood to provide access logs on request (standard turnaround SLA).

Action items I will take:
- Prepare an EU Annex to the addendum reflecting 14-day retention and EU-region pinning (draft attached: Redwood-DPA-Annex-EU.pdf).
- Generate a DocuSign envelope with the DPA + Annex for Meridian to execute.
- Share SOC 2 summary and a link to the audit evidence under NDA if Meridian requires it.

If Meridian is good with the text in the annex, we can route the DocuSign envelope today and get procurement to countersign.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal (Contracts)
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0177
